tasks.build: deno check --frozen serve.ts scripts/setup-instance.ts scripts/sentinel/main.ts scripts/sentinel/rolling-review-worker.ts scripts/sentinel/revision-control.ts scripts/sentinel/rollback-controller.ts
tasks.dev: sh -c 'if [ -f .env ]; then set -a; . ./.env; set +a; fi; export DENO_DEPLOY_TOKEN="${DENO_DEPLOY_TOKEN_UBIQUITY_DAO:-${DENO_DEPLOY_TOKEN:-local-dev-admin}}"; exec deno serve --watch --env --host 127.0.0.1 --allow-env --allow-net --allow-read --unstable-kv serve.ts --disable-admin-auth "$@"' --
tasks.dev:local: sh -c 'if [ -z "${CODEX_AUTH_JSON_B64:-}" ]; then if [ -f "$HOME/.codex/auth.json" ]; then export CODEX_AUTH_JSON_B64="$(base64 < "$HOME/.codex/auth.json" | tr -d "\n")"; echo "Loaded CODEX_AUTH_JSON_B64 from ~/.codex/auth.json"; else echo "No CODEX_AUTH_JSON_B64 and no ~/.codex/auth.json found. /v1/models will stay empty until a model snapshot is initialized."; fi; fi; if [ -f .env ]; then set -a; . ./.env; set +a; fi; export DENO_DEPLOY_TOKEN="${DENO_DEPLOY_TOKEN_UBIQUITY_DAO:-${DENO_DEPLOY_TOKEN:-local-dev-admin}}"; exec deno serve --watch --host 127.0.0.1 --allow-env --allow-net --allow-read --unstable-kv serve.ts --disable-admin-auth "$@"' --
tasks.admin:models: sh -c 'BASE_URL=${BASE_URL:-http://localhost:8000}; admin_token=${DENO_DEPLOY_TOKEN_UBIQUITY_DAO:-${DENO_DEPLOY_TOKEN:-}}; if [ -z "$admin_token" ]; then echo "DENO_DEPLOY_TOKEN_UBIQUITY_DAO (or DENO_DEPLOY_TOKEN) is required for admin endpoints." >&2; exit 1; fi; curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $admin_token" ${BASE_URL}/admin/codex/models'
tasks.admin:models:spark: sh -c 'BASE_URL=${BASE_URL:-http://localhost:8000}; admin_token=${DENO_DEPLOY_TOKEN_UBIQUITY_DAO:-${DENO_DEPLOY_TOKEN:-}}; if [ -z "$admin_token" ]; then echo "DENO_DEPLOY_TOKEN_UBIQUITY_DAO (or DENO_DEPLOY_TOKEN) is required for admin endpoints." >&2; exit 1; fi; curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $admin_token" ${BASE_URL}/admin/codex/models | jq -r ".data.models[]?.slug // empty | select(contains(\"-spark\"))"'
tasks.upload:auth: sh -c 'if [ -f .env ]; then set -a; . ./.env; set +a; fi; deno run --allow-env --allow-net --allow-read scripts/upload-codex-auth.ts "$@"' --
tasks.keys:create: deno run --env --allow-env --allow-net --allow-read scripts/ubq-ai.ts admin keys create
tasks.keys:list: deno run --env --allow-env --allow-net --allow-read scripts/ubq-ai.ts admin keys list
tasks.keys:revoke: deno run --env --allow-env --allow-net --allow-read scripts/ubq-ai.ts admin keys revoke
tasks.logs:pull: sh -c 'token_var=; if [ -n "${DENO_DEPLOY_TOKEN_UBIQUITY_DAO:-}" ]; then token_var="$DENO_DEPLOY_TOKEN_UBIQUITY_DAO"; elif [ -n "${DENO_DEPLOY_TOKEN:-}" ]; then token_var="$DENO_DEPLOY_TOKEN"; else echo "DENO_DEPLOY_TOKEN_UBIQUITY_DAO (or DENO_DEPLOY_TOKEN) is required to pull Deno Deploy logs." >&2; exit 1; fi; mkdir -p logs; log_file="logs/deno-deploy-$(date -u +%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ).jsonl"; echo "Saving logs to $log_file" >&2; DENO_DEPLOY_TOKEN="$token_var" deno deploy logs --json --non-interactive --once --org ubiquity-dao --app ai-ubq-fi "$@" > "$log_file"' --
tasks.test: deno test --frozen --env --allow-net=127.0.0.1 --allow-env=CEREBRAS_API_KEY,VOYAGEAI_API_KEY,METERED_API_KEY,SURPLUS_API_KEY,IMAGE_BASE_MODEL,GIT_REVISION,GITHUB_SHA,DENO_DEPLOYMENT_ID,DENO_DEPLOY_BUILD_ID --ignore=lib/codex --ignore=tests/failover-stress-http.test.ts --ignore=tests/usage-optimization-measurement.test.ts tests && deno task test:measurement
tasks.fmt: deno fmt serve.ts src tests scripts docs benchmarks
tasks.lint: deno lint serve.ts src tests scripts benchmarks
